input_mode.label: Input mode
input_mode.description: The four scenarios are mutually exclusive; a request can only be in one of them. Clear media that does not belong to the selected mode after switching.

text.label: Text to video (prompt only)
text.description: Submits the prompt only, with no image, video or audio material.

keyframes.label: First frame / first and last frame
keyframes.description: One image as the first frame, or two images as the first and last frame. Cannot be combined with reference video or audio.

reference.label: Multimodal reference
reference.description: Up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos and 3 reference audios. Audio alone cannot be used as a reference.

first_frame.label: First frame image
first_frame.description: Used as the opening frame. Aspect ratio 0.4–2.5, each edge 300–6000 px, under 30 MB. Material containing real human faces is rejected upstream.

last_frame.label: Last frame image
last_frame.description: Used as the closing frame, paired with the first frame image. Same constraints as the first frame image.

reference_images.label: Reference images
reference_images.description: Up to 9. Aspect ratio 0.4–2.5, each edge 300–6000 px, under 30 MB. Material containing real human faces is rejected upstream.

reference_videos.label: Reference videos
reference_videos.description: Up to 3 MP4 clips, each 2–15 seconds and under 200 MB. Reference video and audio combined must stay within 15 seconds.

reference_audios.label: Reference audios
reference_audios.description: Up to 3 WAV / MP3 clips, each 2–15 seconds. Audio alone cannot be used as a reference; at least one reference image or video must accompany it.

ratio.label: Aspect ratio
ratio.description: Seven official options, default adaptive (follows the input content).

duration.label: Duration (seconds)
duration.description: An integer from 4 to 15, or Smart duration (decided by prompt complexity, roughly 5 seconds); default 5 seconds. Frame rate is fixed at 24 fps.

generate_audio.label: Generate audio
generate_audio.description: Enabled by default. Turning it off submits a silent video.

return_last_frame.label: Return last frame image
return_last_frame.description: When enabled, a successful task also returns the last frame image URL for continued shooting.

watermark.label: Display watermark
watermark.description: Disabled by default. Platform-enforced visible watermark, C2PA and invisible watermark are unrelated to this switch.

seed.label: Random seed
seed.description: A reproducibility aid; left empty the field is not submitted. The provider does not guarantee exact reproduction.
